_comment: MCP servers for the chat agent under the chat supervisor (agent/supervisor/chat-supervisor.mjs passes this file as --mcp-config). phone-channel provides the reply/get_location tools (EDVA_PHONE_PRIMARY marks it as the one Supabase subscriber); tools is agent/tools-mcp scoped to the chat agent. No secrets here: ${VAR} placeholders are expanded from the environment, which process-manager.mjs loads from .env (EDVA_HOME is written there by `edva init` and exported by `edva up`). Add your own servers in a copy outside the repo only if they name accounts or machine paths.
